what_happened: Found an undocumented third edit site: scripts/test-state-write-concurrency.sh (sibling of state-write.sh, not under scripts/tests/) has dedicated --allocate-into test Cases 10-14; Case 12 (and test-validate-state.sh Fixtures (c)/(g)) expect a FAIL that the corrected membership-based bound would invert to a PASS. Documented exact fixture values and current assertion text in the research report so the implementation phase does not miss them.

Research report's enumeration of the four inverting test fixtures (Case 12, Fixtures c/g, plus Case 13's assertion) and the bash-level counter-advance assertion as a third edit site let the plan size Phases 2 and 4 from measured facts instead of re-deriving them; planning needed only targeted confirmation reads.

Planning discovered a coupling neither the dispatch nor the research report names: five suites copy state-write.sh into a throwaway temp root with a hard-coded lib allow-list, so adding any source line to state-write.sh breaks all five. Folded into Phase 2 as a named sweep sub-step with its own grep command plus a Risks row.

test-manifest-scripts-sync.sh's no-REPO_ROOT-override assertion fails pre-existingly in this repo (sync-manifest-scripts.sh assumes a local agent-system/extensions dir, but this repo's source store is external via .claude-extensions.json); reproduced independent of any phase-1 change; 18/19 other assertions pass.

The derived-allocator design (counter as regenerable cache, number derived from the in-use set, recording assertion + cache regeneration replacing the monotonic-advance assertion) worked cleanly against every hand-built fixture on the first implementation pass: dense allocation, outlier-skip, in-use-counter refusal, and both main/dry-run recording-assertion refusals all produced byte-identical expected output. The 5 lib-allow-list-extended suites unrelated to allocation semantics (spill-names, large-payload, regen-timing, orchestrate-cycle-plan) all passed unchanged, confirming the sourcing change alone introduced no regressions.

Phase 4's plan enumeration named Fixtures (b)/(c)/(d)/(g) for text/outcome realignment but not (a); confirmed (a)'s PASS-text assertion also needs updating (outcome unchanged, but Check 12's PASS wording changed in Phase 2). Recorded in phase-2-progress.json deviations for Phase 4 to pick up.
